stepTitle: A sine function crosses the y-axis at $$y=\frac{1}{2}$$. Its maximum value is $$2$$, and its minimum value is $$-1$$. It attains its maximum at $$x=\frac{\pi}{8}$$ and its minimum at $$x=\frac{-\pi}{8}$$. \n The function shown is of the form $$y=A\sin(Bx)+D.$$ Identify the vertical shift $$D.$$
